data.headline: Rewiring. Not retiring. 💥 On sabbatical 💥 Award-Winning New York Business Attorney & Strategist ready to forge a new identity 💥 Lovin’ the Lowcountry Stargazers 💥 5K Race Runner
data.about:
Nina L. Kaufman, Esq. has been an SBA Small Business Champion, an entrepreneurship Influencer (Forbes Magazine), Entrepreneur.com columnist and blogger, and go-to legal advisor for countless New York business owners. 

In 2021, she moved to a state she had never seen. And, she’s walking away from a successful 25-year entrepreneurial career to start a new chapter of her life. One that allows her the freedom to explore what’s next without being tethered to what’s now. 

Why? Because “the day came when the risk to remain tight in a bud was more painful than the risk it took to blossom.” Kaufman Business Law is no longer taking clients and Nina is going on sabbatical to pursue professional and personal growth. If you’re curious about what Nina is up to, visit her personal site at NinaKaufman.com.

An educator at heart, Nina has reached hundreds of thousands of business owners over the years through her media appearances, articles, podcasts, and frequent speaking at business conferences. Nina believes that small businesses are the lifeblood of our economy and deserve to be supported and protected. As a seasoned business owner, she understands first-hand the financial demands, commitment, and “blood, sweat, and tears” of being an entrepreneurial leader. Building her own business from the ground up gave her perspective and real-life experience that many corporate and legal advisors lack. She parlayed that into her book, The Entrepreneur's Prenup: How to Choose a Business Partner Who Won't [bleep] You, available on  Amazon.com. 

In her personal life, Nina enjoys running 5K races with her husband and chanting Torah. (Not simultaneously). She’s been well-equipped for life with a strong sense of humor that served her as both a lawyer and as a former stand-up comic in NYC. Nina received her Bachelor’s degree from Wellesley College (cum laude), her Master’s degree from the London School of Economics & Political Science, and her law degree from Boston University.

description.text:
I am taking extended time away from law to pursue my professional and academic growth, to learn and develop new skills, and – most importantly – to rest and recuperate.

Why? Because – if not now, when?

The Jewish philosopher Martin Buber tells this story in his Tales of the Hasidim:

A rabbi named Zusya died and went to stand before the judgment seat of God. As he waited for God to appear, he grew nervous thinking about his life and how little he had done. He began to imagine that God was going to ask him, “Why weren’t you Moses or why weren’t you Solomon or why weren’t you David?” But when God appeared, the rabbi was surprised. God simply asked, “Why weren’t you Zusya?”

That’s why I owe it to myself to get off the hamster wheel and explore these issues now. I can’t focus on “what’s next?” while I’m mired in “what’s now?” So I have to let go of the life I had planned. To stop chasing status and validation. To reframe my definition of success. For now, I am an EXPLORER, sailing into the unknown of “what’s next for Nina?”

Where am I being led? Rabbinical school? Choral music? Travel? A fresh use for my law license?

I have no idea. (Yet). But I can promise you this:

It’ll be a helluva journey.

At Kaufman Business Law, we believe business owners deserve to be paid, protected, and prosperous. Our mission was to guide our clients in balancing the growth they want to see with the legal risks they need to manage for success.

For over 25 years, we’ve advocated for small creative businesses, consulting firms, and professional service companies – all of whom are optimistic curators with type-A personalities to get the job done. We knew the signs of a deal going sideways before it was too late to act, which saved clients time, money, and unnecessary aggravation.

Kaufman Business Law is no longer taking clients as of January 2023. After decades of guiding small business owners to make more money with fewer headaches so they can live their best lives, founder Nina Kaufman will be taking a sabbatical to live her own best life and explore “What’s next?” 

By all Emersonian measures, Kaufman Business Law was a hugely successful firm. It gave Nina (the lawyer) a vehicle to serve with integrity, leave the world a little better and more prosperous (through the power of entrepreneurship), and help her clients breathe easier – for which she is truly grateful. 

To follow Nina Kaufman's Rewiring Not Retiring journey, visit her personal website at NinaKaufman.com

description.text:
92% of small business owners can never afford to stop working. Never understand the root cause of why they're working so hard and have no clue how to replace themselves in their business. They’re left running around like headless chickens. 


Solving these problems was Nina Kaufman's focus at Business Exponential. Her purpose is to support small knowledge-based businesses to make more money with fewer headaches. 


Nina showed seasoned owners of expertise-driven service businesses (like marketing, consulting, professional, and creative firms) how to simplify, focus, and leverage their efforts so their business can scale profitably. Putting more money in their pocket, more options for "down the road," and more time on their calendar...for everything else they want to do in life.


Her proprietary 5-step SCALE system provided a roadmap to reshaping your business so it supports your life, instead of running your life. This roadmap integrated into the elite consulting program that provided hands-on, done-with-you strategic guidance and accountability support to make it easy to implement.  


In 2022 Business Exponential was integrated into Kaufman Business Law. This New York law firm is uniquely positioned to support you with all the best elements of Business Exponential so that you are paid, protected, and prosperous. Because business professionals deserve to work with great clients, detect business risks early, and create a legacy that lets you live your best life.
Associate attorney at several NYC law firms, handling commercial transactions and litigation
